headline: Embraer Announces ADS Forward Split and Ratio Change
summary: Embraer announced it will execute a forward split of its American Depositary Shares and alter the ratio from one ADS representing four ordinary shares to one ADS representing one ordinary share.
why: Share ratio adjustments and forward splits alter the per-share trading price of American Depositary Receipts to improve liquidity and retail accessibility.

impacts.name: Embraer
impacts.why: ADS ratio changes modify the trading denomination of foreign shares in US markets.
